{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "units installed before 2018",
    "condition_is_relative": false,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "Disable the interface and enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "That happens on units installed before 2018. Disable the interface and enable it again, don't reboot.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Did that, traffic is back.",
    "about_entity": "TRN-019",
    "retracts": false
  },
  "reason": "An expert states a reusable rule for when a new SFP shows link up and zero counters on units installed before 2018: bounce the interface and do not reboot."
}
